description: K_link = HKDF-Expand-SHA256(PRK K_root, info 'medium' || 0x03, 32 bytes), K_root the R2 pairwise root of the two Ed25519 identity keys (RAVEN_PRIVATE_RENDEZVOUS_V1 §5.3a, shared-vectors/rvn1/lan_beacon/lbcn_pair_keys_001.json). kq_X->Y = HMAC-SHA256(K_link, 'knock-q' || X || Y), kr_X->Y = HMAC-SHA256(K_link, 'knock-r' || X || Y). Message 1 payload = nonce16 || tag16 || pad(0..31), tag16 = HMAC-SHA256(kq_A->B, 'rlk1/m1' || day u32 BE || nonce16 || e_A)[0..16], day = floor(unix_ms / 86400000); message 2 payload = proof16 || pad(0..31), proof16 = HMAC-SHA256(kr_B->A, 'rlk1/m2' || nonce16 || e_A || s_B)[0..16]; A dials, B listens (RAVEN_LINK_KNOCK_V1 §3)
name: RLK1 negative: knocks made with another pair's or the other direction's key
